_documentation.purpose: Isolate whether a stationary, displaced optical hotspot creates a directed thermal drive and measurable single-vortex response.
_documentation.relies_on: Builds configs/simulations/nbn_optical_vortex_unpinned.json; that simulation selects the NbN material, 100 nm film, two-temperature heat solver, and TDGL integrator. A pinned comparison can use nbn_optical_vortex_two_temperature.json.
_documentation.authority: Values here set the experiment. The referenced simulation supplies material, geometry, solver tolerances, and timestep; this runner explicitly controls the field, seed, laser, and zero applied current.

fields.simulation_config: Base simulation file to build, including material and numerical settings.
fields.applied_field_T: Uniform perpendicular magnetic field in tesla.
fields.initial_vortex.x_fraction: Initial vortex x as a fraction of film width; between-node seeding prevents ambiguous plaquette winding.
fields.initial_vortex.y_fraction: Initial vortex y as a fraction of film height.
fields.initial_vortex.charge: Topological sign of the seeded vortex; +1 here.
fields.initial_vortex.core_radius_cells: Initial core radius in mesh cells.
fields.seed_position_m: Physical location of the seeded vortex in metres; used for core tracking and beam offset.
fields.beam_offset_m: Vector from vortex to the positive stationary beam in metres; the negative control reverses it.
fields.absorbed_power_W: Power absorbed by the film, not incident optical power, in watts.
fields.spot_sigma_m: Gaussian optical spot standard deviation in metres.
fields.minimum_directional_response_nm: Smallest dark-subtracted core shift toward both mirrored beams required to flag directional response; in nanometres.
fields.timing.dark_steps: Coupled steps with laser off before cloning the same prepared state into all three controls.
fields.timing.exposure_steps: Coupled steps for each dark, positive-offset, and negative-offset branch.
fields.timing.sample_every: Number of steps between spatial-gradient and vortex-core diagnostics.
fields.output_directory: Base result directory; a numbered sibling is reserved if it already exists.
